Package com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote

Record Class QuotePreviewController.QuotePreviewResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote.QuotePreviewController.QuotePreviewResponse
Record Components:
symbol - instrument symbol; null on error
side - requested side, or N/A when not supplied; null on error
quantity - requested quantity, or 0 when not supplied; null on error
indicativePrice - indicative price, not a guaranteed fill price; null on error
quotedAt - time of the cached quote; null on error
indicative - true when the price is an indicative estimate
error - error code; null on success
errorMessage - readable error description; null on success
Enclosing class:
QuotePreviewController
public static record QuotePreviewController.QuotePreviewResponse(String symbol, String side, Long quantity, BigDecimal indicativePrice, OffsetDateTime quotedAt, Boolean indicative, String error, String errorMessage) extends Record
Response object for quote preview requests.
